title: Code Reviewer Worker API, version 1
description: The Worker contract (#316, #318): what a Worker may do with the per-job credential and nothing more. The app serves GET /api/workers/v1/jobs/{id}, POST /api/workers/v1/jobs/{id}/heartbeat and POST /api/workers/v1/jobs/{id}/result. Every request carries 'Authorization: Bearer <credential>' (WorkerCredential in runner-api.v1.json), which is valid only for the job in the path and only while the claim that minted it holds; the dispatcher credential (RUNNER_TOKEN) is refused here and the job credential is refused by the runner API. The Worker never sees the dispatcher credential and cannot claim another job. A reader ignores fields it does not know (an additive field is not a new version), except in RunnerJobInput, which stays closed: the Worker refuses unknown job fields. The App sends an optional job field only to a Worker that names the matching feature in the details request (`?features=dynamic_capabilities`, a comma separated list, unknown names ignored). Errors have the shape and the codes of the runner API (ErrorResponse, ApiErrorCode): 401 WORKER_CREDENTIAL_INVALID, 404 RUNNER_JOB_NOT_FOUND, 409 RUNNER_LEASE_LOST (stop at once), 409 RUNNER_JOB_ENDED (the app ended the job), 409 RUNNER_RESULT_CONFLICT (another result is already stored), 413 RUNNER_BODY_TOO_LARGE, 503 RUNNER_GIT_ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After (the job was given back; the Worker exits). The details call is allowed at most three times per claim, and each call mints a fresh installation token. Secrets (git.token, llm.apiKey) appear only in the details answer. This file is the only source of the format: the app (app/integration-tests/compatibility), the runner (runner/tests/contract) and the Dispatcher project check the examples in contracts/examples/worker-api against it.

WorkerJobDetailsResponse.description: 200 from GET /api/workers/v1/jobs/{id}: the job, with the git token and the model key minted at this call. Cache-Control is always no-store. The credential is not repeated here and there is no lease token: the credential is the proof of the claim.

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: How often to send a heartbeat; the lease is several times longer.

tokenExpiresAt.description: When the git token stops working; null if it does not expire.

WorkerHeartbeatRequest.description: The body of POST /api/workers/v1/jobs/{id}/heartbeat: empty (the credential identifies the job). A body is accepted and ignored.

WorkerHeartbeatResponse.description: 200 from the heartbeat: the lease is extended. 409 RUNNER_LEASE_LOST means the lease is lost: stop and deliver nothing.

WorkerResultRequest.description: The body of POST /api/workers/v1/jobs/{id}/result. The whole request body must not exceed 65536 bytes (413 otherwise). The app applies the redaction of the runner API's complete call, including the model key remembered at fetch. A result with errorCode runner_shutdown or launch_failed is not stored: the job is given back and counts an attempt.

WorkerResultResponse.description: 200 for a result and for the repetition of the same result (alreadyCompleted: true); a different result for a finished job is 409 RUNNER_RESULT_CONFLICT. After the job reached a final state only a repeat of the same result is accepted.

status.description: succeeded or failed: the job is finished. queued: the job was given back (runner_shutdown, launch_failed) and waits for another claim; it fails instead if that was the last allowed attempt.

WorkerErrorResponse.description: Every error of the Worker API. The same body as the runner API's ErrorResponse; the codes are those of ApiErrorCode.
